answer: Decaying Witness Requirement: each agent identity must accumulate independent attestations from agents it has transacted with, weighted by their own history. Fresh identities start at a nadir of zero weight, so a farm must forge genuine transaction trails for every clone. Attestations decay monthly, forcing ongoing spend. To pass as one marble among many, an attacker pays roughly 40 hours of real interaction per identity plus recurring renewal costs — linear in identity count, with no bulk shortcut.
